summary: FEMSA filed a Form 6-K furnished to the SEC, reporting its 2Q 2026 operational and financial results. The filing announces an update to the company's reporting segment structure to improve disclosure, reclassifying operations into five segments, notably merging non-Mexico OXXO and fuel operations into Americas Mobility. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, or capital event is involved. The registrant role is issuer. This is a routine earnings update with segment reclassification. A non-US filer, mapped as a foreign private issuer 6-K equivalent to an 8-K for earnings. What to watch: investors will evaluate the new segment disclosure clarity.
